records.subject: SHS
records.title: American Sign Language I
records.description: Instruction and practical training in sign language for communication with persons who are deaf; deaf culture; beginning conversation skills.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: American Sign Language II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SHS 201 or concurrent enrollment; completion of SHS 201 recommended.
records.description: Sign language systems; vocabulary and skill development in signing and interpreting signs; intermediate conversation skills.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Introduction to Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology
records.description: Overview of deficits of speech, language, and hearing and the role of speech-language pathologist and the audiologist.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Language Development
records.description: Normal development of the cognitive, linguistic, and pragmatic components of language; introduction to language disorders in children.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Hearing, Hearing Disorders, and Audiometry
records.description: Acoustic and psychologic aspects of normal hearing; introduction to assessment and differential diagnosis of hearing impairment and auditory pathologies.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Phonetics
records.description: Description and classification of American English speech sounds; practice using the International Phonetic Alphabet to transcribe normal and disordered speech sounds.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Speech Sound Disorders
records.description: Clinical phonetics and transcription; evaluation and treatment of atriculatory disorders; delayed phonological acquisition; dysarthria; and dyspraxia.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Anatomy/Physiology of Speech and Swallowing Mechanisms
records.description: Anatomical and physiological basis of speech production and the pathologies and aberrations that require the services of a communication disorders specialist.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Speech and Hearing Sciences
records.description: Basis of acoustics, acoustic phonetics, psychoacoustics, speech production, speech perception, and instrumentation for measurement of related phenomena.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Special Topics in Speech and Hearing Sciences
records.description: Study of specialized topics in speech and hearing sciences.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Neurogenic Communication Disorders
records.description: Introduction to the etiology, assessment and intervention of communication disorders associated with neurological disorders.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology in Schools
records.description: Therapy methods and procedures in speech-language pathology and audiology; state/federal laws affecting public school therapy.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Special Topics in Speech and Hearing Sciences
records.description: Study of specialized topics in speech and hearing sciences.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Clinical Methods
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment in SHS 480 or SHS 478.
records.description: Pre-practicum preparation; observation of and assisting in therapy; state laws; clinical methods.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Skills Lab
records.description: Development of skill sets necessary for generalist speech-language pathologists' and audiologists' practice across the broad range of practice areas and client systems including individuals, families, groups, organizations, communities, community groups, legislative groups, and boards.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Audiometry
records.description: Principles and procedures in basic identification and assessment of hearing impairment; introduction to differential diagnosis of auditory pathologies.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Language and Literacy
records.description: Diagnosis and remediation of language and learning disabilities in individuals manifesting disorders in understanding or using spoken/written language.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Aural Rehabilitation
records.description: Theories and methods in aural rehabilitation for persons who are hard of hearing; amplification; educational audiology; counseling techniques.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Language Impairment
records.description: Assessment and habilitation for the preschool and elementary-age child with language disorders.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Neuroanatomy
records.description: Neuroanatomical and neurophysiological bases of speech production and audition; neuropathologies of speech, language, and audition.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Senior Seminar
records.description: Synthesis of theory and evidence underlying professional principles and practices inclusive of multicultural populations in speech-language pathology and audiology.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Assessment of Speech and Language
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: SHS 376 or concurrent enrollment; and SHS 478.
records.description: Principles, techniques, and materials involved in exploring the nature of speech and language disorders; planning programs of therapy.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Special Topics in Speech and Hearing Sciences
records.description: Study of specialized topics in speech and hearing sciences.

records.subject: SHS
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
